description: Search ARES by company name, city, street, PSČ, or NACE code. Combines all filters with AND. Useful when user knows name but not IČO, looking for companies in a building, or all businesses in a sector.

nace.description: Filter by CZ-NACE activity codes, 2-6 digits. E.g., ["62"] for IT.

query.description: Partial or full company name (obchodní jméno).

street.description: Filter by street name (nazev ulice), e.g. "Radlická".

name: search_companies
